newsitem.title: POLAND: POLISH SHARES CLOSE MIXED IN CONTINUOUS TRADE.
newsitem.headline: POLISH SHARES CLOSE MIXED IN CONTINUOUS TRADE.

text.p: Seventeen stocks fell, five rose and six were flat in 22.4-million-zloty Warsaw bourse continuous trade on Tuesday with the WIG 20 index up 1.7 percent to 1,733.1 points.
In comparison with their main market fixing 26 stocks rose and two fell.
The remaining two stocks did not trade.
The National Investment Fund NIF index rose 0.7 percent to 140.1 points in 1.1-million-zloty trade.
NFI units fell 0.7 percent to 138 zlotys in a 13.1-million-zloty turnover. -- Warsaw Newsroom +48 22 653 9700
